definition_zh: 按不同尺度组织结构单元及系统矩阵的组装方法。
usage_overview: 用于将采用不同网格尺寸的结构层连接为统一耦合模型，使各层可按自身尺度离散，并通过层间连接共同参与系统动力分析。

P091.title: Further research of multi-scale assemble and matrix reassemble method for efficient analysis of railway track–substructure system subjected to a moving train
P091.authors: L Xu, L Wu, Z Li, B Peng, T Lu, Z Yu
P091.label: Xu等（2025）

complete_examples.text: In this work, a three-dimensional and coupled model for multi-rigid-body of train and finite elements of track and substructures is presented by multi-scale assemble and matrix reassemble method.

The matrix reassembling tactic is based on the multi-scale assemble method, through which the finite element matrix bandwidth is greatly narrowed, and the Cholesky factorization, iterative and multi-time-step solution have been introduced to efficiently obtain the train, track and substructure responses.
